classes.name: Event
classes.description: This class manages event registration, triggering, unregistration, and cleanup within the OpenCart system, enabling a flexible and extensible event-driven architecture.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Event object with a Registry instance.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new event trigger with associated action and priority.

methods.name: trigger
methods.description: Triggers all actions associated with an event that match the trigger pattern.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters an event by trigger and route.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all events associated with a specific trigger.
